visualCharacteristics.purpose: Highlight tiles led by a large stat or key word (3x, 5%, Earn) with a label and supporting text; also used for rewards-rate strips, image cards and icon link rows

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: optional image/icon cell, then a body cell whose first heading (or fully bold first paragraph) is the stat, followed by label and text paragraphs or lists; a body holding only one link makes the whole tile clickable

reuseGuidance: Default: outlined stat tiles. rate-strip for a single panel of earn rates split by rules; with-image for photo-topped cards; icon-links for centred icon + link rows; coloured-tiles-with-icons and the colour-sequence options (blue-cyan-dark, blue-dark, blue-dark-red, cyan-grey) for filled earn-rate tiles.
